title: Giant Defy Advanced SL 1 ride note
notes: Exact-trim title and body. Community ride note dated 2025-09-18 claims a 7.4 kg complete weight (not measured). Body says Defy Advanced SL feels stiff at the BB and head tube; mentions Giant D-Fuse contact-point comfort as brand copy. Comparison BOM (2022 TCR Advanced 2 with SRAM Rival AXS and Hunt aero wheels) is the other bike, not the SL 1. No CNY price, purchase route, size, groupset, wheels, geometry, or model year.
